column1: # French ingredient names Open Food Facts' taxonomy lacks (#901).
# Written for manage_our_home, not taken from Open Food Facts: see README.md.
#     <name as a recipe writes it> TAB <Open Food Facts category id>
# The name is read as `Taxonomy::canonical_ingredient` reads one (case,
# plurals, accents, `de`/`du`/`des`), and joins the category's French names:
# a name two unrelated categories share is still no tag. A test checks that
# every line names a category of `off-categories-fr.tsv.gz` and takes effect.
